Hi @Contact.FirstName@,
Welcome to Dynamic Media! We’re thrilled to work with you.
As a new customer you have access to the Dynamic Media Customer Portal, which can be found at http://demo.dynamicmediamusic.com/Portal/.
Your login information:
Username: @DemoUserName@
Temporary Password: @DemoPassword@
Take a few minutes to login with the information provided above. The portal gives you access to your account; plus, everything you need to manage messaging for your business.
With the portal, you can:
Upload new messages
Build message schedules
Assign schedules to your player
If you have any questions or need assistance getting started, feel free to reach out.
Call us Monday–Friday, 9 AM–6 PM ET at 586-978-4214.
Thank you,
The Dynamic Media Team
